PreToolUse._comment: The Bash hook-guard is DELIBERATELY OFF (ADR 0078 A28, 2026-07-15). It injected 'MANDATORY: run graphify before grepping' into EVERY Bash call, including the `docker exec ... psql` calls that are the ONLY valid way to audit authorization here — graphify does not index SQL, and this program's founding finding is that file text is stale, so the live catalog (pg_proc/pg_policies/prosecdef) is the sole truth. An agent that COMPLIED with the hook would answer authorization questions from a stale index. Read|Glob stays ON: graphify-first for app-code files is correct and deliberate. Re-enable only if graphify ever indexes SQL.
